notes.title: Future Plans, Upcoming Playtest & Demo Update
notes.notes: [h3]Hello everyone![/h3][p]We’re actively working on the release version of [b]Dead Station Files[/b], but the demo is not being left behind. We want it to give a better idea of the full game, without revealing all the surprises and ideas we have prepared for you.[/p][p][/p][h3]Our near-term plans:[/h3][list][*][p]Several small patches for the demo[/p][/*][*][p]Further development of the game’s art direction[/p][/*][*][p]A brand new trailer (finally!)[/p][/*][*][p]Improvements to the Dead Station Files Steam page[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Upcoming playtest[/h3][p]Very soon, we’ll open sign-ups for the playtest of the release version, where we’ll be testing the progression system to make the game as engaging and well-balanced as possible — the way we envision it, and the way you want it to be.[/p][p]We plan to launch the playtest in waves, and by joining it you’ll be able to invite up to three friends to participate![/p][p][/p][h3]What’s new in this update:[/h3][list][*][p]Skip function for the post-level station event report[/p][/*][*][p]Color schemes for improved accessibility[/p][/*][*][p]A run duration timer[/p][/*][*][p]Forced 16:9 display mode (for ultrawide and non-standard monitors)[/p][/*][*][p]2 new equipment items[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3]Fixes and adjustments:[/h3][list][*][p]Improved display of the current level on the station[/p][/*][*][p]Focus effects are now shown inside story files[/p][/*][*][p]Updated item sprites[/p][/*][*][p]Balance adjustments[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous bug fixes[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Thank you for following the project and helping us shape [b]Dead Station Files[/b].[/p][p]See you aboard [b]Chernobog XIII[/b]![/p]

notes.title: DEMO UPDATE 0.7 IS HERE!
notes.notes: [h2]Welcome to Dead Station Files 0.7![/h2][p]We’ve prepared a major update featuring brand-new mechanics and numerous gameplay improvements inspired by your feedback.[/p][p]This update is designed to increase the replayability of the demo and lay the groundwork for future content expansions.[/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][h3][b]INVESTIGATION FOCUS[/b][/h3][p]The new Focus mechanic lets you approach the catastrophe from a different angle. Use Data Files unlocked by completing Tasks to alter your entry point into the disaster.[/p][p]Each Data File sets unique starting conditions such as time, level, or station state. Experiment with configurations to unlock new Files and narrative fragments, and to access events and locations unavailable in the default scenario.[/p][p]All collected Data Files are displayed in the Analysis Screen, where you can also access the Focus Panel.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]EQUIPMENT SYSTEM EXPANSION[/b][/h3][p]There is now more Equipment—and it’s more diverse. It is divided into two categories:[/p][list][*][p][b]Tracked [/b]— exceptionally powerful items that unlock new ways to interact with the environment. These are stored in compartments with lockers, and their presence can be detected when scanning the station map.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Untracked[/b] — standard items that affect your character’s stats. These are found in compartments with shelving. When discovered, you can choose one of three options to best match your playstyle.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]NEW LEVEL MECHANICS[/b][/h3][p]New mechanics and content have been added. Levels are now more diverse, and threats are more dangerous.[/p][list][*][p][b]Decompression[/b] — some levels may be depressurized. Exposure to vacuum is dangerous, but repairing hull breaches will eliminate the threat.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Fire[/b] — spreading fire now present a serious danger. Smart route planning helps avoid unnecessary contact. You can break through flames, extinguish small fires, or suppress them by triggering decompression in burning compartments.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Airlock Rework (DOCK)[/b] — the DOCK speccomp now expels the compartment’s contents into space only when its terminal is active. The terminal can be manually disabled or damaged. If damaged while active, the speccomp may become a source of decompression on the level.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New airlock types:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Blocked[/b] — prevents movement but can be manually cleared.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Malfunctioning[/b] — cannot be controlled and opens/closes on a timer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Secured[/b] — blocks Biosignature movement when closed.[/p][/*][/list][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]EVACOM™ NECROLOG[/b][/h3][p]You can now review your turn history upon death and analyze both your own mistakes and actions of threats by clicking the appropriate button on the death screen.[/p][p]This is an early version of the mechanic, introduced in response to your feedback.[/p][p]Its goal is to help with onboarding and make certain game systems more transparent.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]NEW MUSIC AND SOUND DESIGN[/b][/h3][p]We’ve further expanded the game’s audio landscape with numerous major and minor additions:[/p][list][*][p][b]Sound effects[/b] — many in-game elements and events now have unique audio cues.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Environment[/b] — the station’s ambient soundscape has become even richer.[/p][/*][*][p][b]New music[/b] — completing Tasks and certain game events are now accompanied by musical stingers.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]QOL IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][p]Update 0.7 includes multiple quality-of-life improvements, including:[/p][list][*][p][b]Outcome indication[/b] — consequences of your actions are now clearly shown in the Events Panel, with color-coded difficulty.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Hidden events[/b] — events are now categorized by the complexity of Task chains that lead to them.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Effects panel[/b] — active equipment effects are now displayed in the Analysis Screen.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Spawn indicator[/b] — your starting compartment is now highlighted with blinking when a level begins.[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][h3][b]CHINESE LOCALIZATION[/b][/h3][p]Full support for Simplified Chinese has been added.[/p][p][/p][p][/p][hr][/hr][p][/p][p][b]That’s just part of what’s new — the rest you’ll discover in-game![/b][/p][p][/p][p]Thanks to everyone who joined us over the past weeks and actively shared observations and suggestions. Your feedback helped us refine existing mechanics and identify exciting directions for the game’s future.[/p][p][/p][p]Stay tuned. There's much more ahead![/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Update 0.7 Announcement
notes.notes:
[p]We're hard at work on the next update. This version will add a new language to the game and make the experience clearer and more engaging — but not easier.
[/p][h3][b]1. EQUIPMENT SYSTEM UPDATE[/b][/h3][p][b]Gear will now be divided into two types:[/b][/p][list][*][p][b]Tracked[/b] — discovered on the station via scanner or level status (as before)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Untracked[/b] — more situational, found only by searching a level and offering a choice of 3 options[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Additionally:[/b][/p][list][*][p]New samples of each type will be added.[/p][/*][*][p]Equipment stats and effects will be displayed in a separate window.[/p][/*][/list][p][i]————————————————————— [/i][/p][p][i]Equipment and its combinations will become an important survival factor.
—————————————————————[/i] [/p][p][/p][h3][b]2. NEW CATASTROPHE MECHANICS ON THE STATION[/b][/h3][p][b]You will now encounter:[/b][/p][list][*][p]Fires[/p][/*][*][p]Decompression[/p][/*][*][p]Broken airlocks[/p][/*][*][p]Blocked passages[/p][/*][/list][p][i]—————————————————————[/i][/p][p][i]Choosing your route through the station will become an even more important survival factor.—————————————————————[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]3. EVENT SYSTEM EXPANSION[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Indication of events triggered by player actions[/p][/*][*][p]Classification of events by rarity / concealment[/p][/*][*][p]More events and quests on the catastrophe timeline[/p][/*][/list][p][i]—————————————————————[/i][/p][p][i]Events will now be more interconnected and influenced by your actions, allowing you to uncover hidden key events and escape paths for investigating the catastrophe.[/i][/p][p][i]—————————————————————[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]4. UNLOCKING ACCESS TO THE STATION’S SPACEPORT ZONE[/b][/h3][p][b]You will now be able to proceed further[/b] — into the most dangerous part of the station.[/p][p]The [b]Spaceport Zone[/b] will become a late-game area for the first character: if they miss all exits, they will have to descend there — amid the full collapse of the station.[/p][p]New hidden exits (in addition to the always-available “Naviy” freighter) and new quests will appear inside.[/p][p][i]—————————————————————[/i][/p][p][i]In the full version of the game, the Spaceport Zone will become a full-fledged challenge — with new content and serious threats for all characters.[/i][/p][p][i]—————————————————————[/i][/p][p][/p][h3][b]5. OTHER ADDITIONS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Viewing the last moves[/b] of the player and the monster after death[/p][/*][*][p]Numerous [b]QoL improvements[/b] and fixes[/p][/*][*][p][b]New audio content[/b][/p][/*][*][p][b]More unlockables[/b] in the demo version[/p][/*][*][p][b]New language[/b] — Simplified Chinese[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]This is only part of the planned changes — [b]the rest you’ll discover yourself.[/b][/p]
